# Smartbase - full text (About, Documentation, Privacy Policy, Terms)

Source: https://smartbase.de5.net | Updated: 2026-10-18

# About Miyoni and Smartbase

## Company overview
Miyoni is a technology company that builds simple cloud tools for developers. Our product, **Smartbase**, lets you create databases, run SQL, store files and add "Sign in with Google" to your own website or app without running or maintaining any servers.

## Mission
To make it easy for developers, students and small teams to store data, manage files and sign users in, so they can spend their time building their product instead of setting up infrastructure.

## Vision
A world where anyone with an idea can build a reliable, real application using simple, affordable and well documented tools.

## Products and services
- **Smartbase Databases** - create databases and tables, browse records, and run SQL with joins, grouping, subqueries, views, indexes, constraints and transactions.
- **Smartbase REST API** - read, write and collective API keys, pagination, structured errors and usage limits. Base address: `https://smartbase.de5.net/apiv1`.
- **Smartbase Files** - upload, download and manage files from the dashboard or with an API key.
- **Auth & Email** - Google sign-in for your own websites, flexible storage for your users, one-account-one-device control, and email broadcasts with delivery and open tracking.
- **Documentation** - full guides and API reference at [https://smartbase.de5.net/docs](https://smartbase.de5.net/docs).

## Our story
Smartbase began as a simple idea: a SQL database platform that anyone can use from a phone or a laptop, built on Cloudflare's global network with durable cloud storage behind it. It started with databases, tables and a SQL editor. It then grew to include a full REST API with API keys, a more powerful SQL engine, file storage, and an authentication and email platform so developers can sign users in with Google and keep in touch with them. Today it runs on its own domain, smartbase.de5.net, and we continue to improve it based on what developers need.

## Team and leadership
Smartbase is designed, built and operated by the Miyoni team. For questions about the company, partnerships or press, write to [emalawi19@gmail.com](mailto:emalawi19@gmail.com).

## Contact
- Email: [emalawi19@gmail.com](mailto:emalawi19@gmail.com)
- Website: [https://smartbase.de5.net](https://smartbase.de5.net)

## Company policies
- [Privacy Policy](https://smartbase.de5.net/privacy) - what information we collect, why, and the choices you have.
- [Terms of Service](https://smartbase.de5.net/terms) - the rules for using Smartbase.
- [Documentation](https://smartbase.de5.net/docs) - how the platform works, including limits and security.

# Smartbase documentation

Smartbase is a cloud database and developer platform made by Miyoni. This guide covers the dashboard, the REST API, SQL, file storage and the Auth & Email platform. Base address of the API: `https://smartbase.de5.net/apiv1`.

## Quick start
1. Create an account at [https://smartbase.de5.net](https://smartbase.de5.net) with Google and create a database in the dashboard.
2. Open **API Center** and create an API key. A *read* key can only read, a *write* key can change data, and a *collective* key creates one of each.
3. Make your first request:

```bash
curl -X POST https://smartbase.de5.net/apiv1/query \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_READ_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"database_id":"YOUR_DATABASE_ID","sql":"SELECT * FROM customers LIMIT 10"}'
```

## Authentication and API keys
Send your key in the `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY` header, or in an `X-API-Key` header.

| Key type | What it can do |
|---|---|
| read | `GET` requests and SQL that only reads (`SELECT`, `SHOW`, `DESCRIBE`) |
| write | `POST`, `PUT`, `DELETE`, and SQL that changes data or structure |
| collective | Creates one read key and one write key together |

- You can have up to 5 API keys per account. A key is shown only once when it is created, and only a hash is stored.
- API keys cannot create or revoke keys and cannot open the Auth & Email platform.
- Never put a write key in website or mobile app code that users can see. Keep keys on your server.
- Dashboard (browser) requests use `https://smartbase.de5.net/api/v1` with your login session; programs should use `https://smartbase.de5.net/apiv1` with an API key.

## Endpoints
All paths below are relative to `https://smartbase.de5.net/apiv1`. Every response is JSON with `"success": true` or `"success": false` and an `error` code.

| Method | Path | Key | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/databases` | read | List your databases |
| POST | `/databases` | write | Create a database (`name`, optional `description`) |
| GET | `/databases/:databaseId` | read | Get one database |
| PUT / DELETE | `/databases/:databaseId` | write | Update or delete a database |
| GET | `/databases/:databaseId/tables` | read | List tables |
| POST | `/databases/:databaseId/tables` | write | Create a table (`name`, `columns`) |
| GET | `/databases/:databaseId/tables/:tableId/records?page=1&limit=50` | read | List records (limit up to 100) |
| POST | `/databases/:databaseId/tables/:tableId/records` | write | Insert up to 100 records (`records` array) |
| PUT | `.../records/:recordId` | write | Update a record |
| DELETE | `.../records/:recordId` | write | Delete a record |
| POST | `/query` | read or write | Run SQL (`database_id`, `sql`) |
| GET | `/files` and `/files/:name` | read | List or download files |
| PUT / POST / DELETE | `/files` | write | Upload or delete files |
| GET | `/usage` | read | File storage used and remaining |

Column types are `INTEGER`, `FLOAT`, `TEXT`, `BOOLEAN`, `DATE`, `DATETIME` and `JSON`. Example table and record:

```bash
curl -X POST https://smartbase.de5.net/apiv1/databases/DB_ID/tables -H "Authorization: Bearer WRITE_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"customers","columns":[{"name":"name","type":"TEXT","nullable":false},{"name":"age","type":"INTEGER","nullable":true}]}'

curl -X POST https://smartbase.de5.net/apiv1/databases/DB_ID/tables/TABLE_ID/records -H "Authorization: Bearer WRITE_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"records":[{"name":"Ann","age":30}]}'
```

## SQL
Send SQL to `POST /query` with the `database_id` and the `sql` text. You can send several statements separated by `;`. If one statement fails, none of the statements in that request are saved. A script that only reads needs a read key; anything else needs a write key.

Supported SQL:
- `CREATE TABLE` (with `PRIMARY KEY`, `AUTO_INCREMENT`, `UNIQUE`, `NOT NULL`, `DEFAULT`, `CHECK`), `ALTER TABLE`, `DROP TABLE`, `TRUNCATE`, views and indexes.
- `INSERT` (multi-row, `INSERT ... SELECT`, `ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE`), `UPDATE` and `DELETE` with expressions.
- `SELECT` with `DISTINCT`, all `JOIN` types, `WHERE`, `GROUP BY`, `HAVING`, `ORDER BY`, `LIMIT`/`OFFSET`, subqueries, `WITH` (including recursive), `UNION`/`INTERSECT`/`EXCEPT`, `CASE`, `CAST`, `LIKE`, `BETWEEN`, `IN` and more than 60 functions and aggregates.
- `BEGIN`/`COMMIT`/`ROLLBACK`, `SHOW TABLES`, `DESCRIBE`, and `CREATE DATABASE` / `SHOW DATABASES` / `DROP DATABASE`.

Not available yet: window functions (`OVER`), triggers and stored procedures.

```json
{"success": true, "columns": ["customer","spent"], "rows": [{"customer":"Ann","spent":120.5}], "count": 1, "execution_time": 14}
```

## Files
Upload with a write key by sending the file bytes as the body, then download or list with a read key:

```bash
curl -X PUT https://smartbase.de5.net/apiv1/files/photo.jpg -H "Authorization: Bearer WRITE_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: image/jpeg" --data-binary @photo.jpg
curl https://smartbase.de5.net/apiv1/files -H "Authorization: Bearer READ_KEY"
curl -o photo.jpg https://smartbase.de5.net/apiv1/files/photo.jpg -H "Authorization: Bearer READ_KEY"
```
Files can also be uploaded as JSON (`POST /files` with `name`, base64 `data` and `content_type`). Maximum 7 MB per file and 500 MB per account.

## Limits (free plan)
- 20 databases, 50 tables per database, 500 tables in total.
- 5 API keys per account.
- 2 MB request body for normal API calls.
- Files: 7 MB per file, 500 MB per account.
- API keys are limited to 20 requests per minute and 2,000 requests per day. When you reach a limit the API answers `429` with `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` and a retry time.

## Errors
Errors look like `{"success": false, "error": "CODE", "message": "Explanation"}`.

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid API key or login |
| `KEY_PERMISSION_DENIED` | The key type is not allowed for this action (for example a read key trying to write) |
| `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | Too many requests; wait and retry |
| `DATABASE_NOT_FOUND`, `TABLE_NOT_FOUND` | The id does not exist or is not yours |
| `INVALID_SQL`, `SQL_ERROR` | The SQL could not be parsed or failed (nothing was saved) |
| `DATABASE_LIMIT_REACHED`, `TABLE_LIMIT_REACHED` | A free-plan limit was reached |
| `FILE_TOO_LARGE`, `STORAGE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED` | File limits were reached |

## Auth and Email platform
The Auth & Email platform lets visitors of **your** website sign in with Google, and gives you tools to manage those users. Open it from the **Auth & Email** option in the Smartbase menu; you are signed in automatically. It currently runs at https://email.emalawi19.workers.dev.

Add the sign-in button to your site:

```html
<div id="google-login"></div>
<script src="https://email.emalawi19.workers.dev/smartbase.js"></script>
<script>
  Smartbase.init({ projectId: "YOUR_PROJECT_ID" });
  Smartbase.googleButton("#google-login");
  var result = Smartbase.getRedirectResult();
  if (result && result.code) {
    // send result.code to YOUR server, then exchange it with your secret key
  }
</script>
```

On your server, exchange the one-time code for the verified profile with `POST https://email.emalawi19.workers.dev/api/v1/google/exchange`, sending your project key in the `X-Smartbase-Key` header.

Features:
- **Google app options** - use the default Smartbase Google app, or your own Google client ID and secret.
- **Custom sign-in domain** - let Google redirect through your own domain by forwarding `/__smartbase/*` to Smartbase (needs your own Google app).
- **User storage** - keep users with the platform, in your own Smartbase database (ready-made template, or a custom table described with the `smartbase-data.js` SDK), or send each sign-in to your own server through a signed gateway.
- **Account control** - "one account, one device": *monitor* to count real users without duplicates, or *enforce* to block a second account on the same device.
- **Database copy** - download an offline HTML copy of your users' data.
- **Broadcasts** - send test emails and mass emails with sent and opened tracking; every email includes an unsubscribe link.

## Security
- Passwords (for accounts that use one) are stored only as salted hashes, and API keys only as hashes.
- Every request is checked against the account that owns the data.
- Traffic is encrypted with HTTPS. Secrets such as Google client secrets are encrypted before storage.
- Report a security problem to [emalawi19@gmail.com](mailto:emalawi19@gmail.com).

## Frequently asked questions
### Is Smartbase free?
Yes. The free plan includes the limits listed above.

### Can I use Smartbase from my own website or app?
Yes. Create an API key in the API Center and call `https://smartbase.de5.net/apiv1` from your server.

### Can a read key delete data?
No. A read key can only read. Changing data needs a write key.

### Where is my data stored?
Smartbase runs on Cloudflare, and your databases and files are stored as private files in cloud storage operated by Miyoni. See the [Privacy Policy](https://smartbase.de5.net/privacy) for details.

## Support
Email [emalawi19@gmail.com](mailto:emalawi19@gmail.com). Please include your account email and, if relevant, the error code you received (never send API keys or passwords).

# Privacy Policy

Last updated: 18 October 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how Miyoni ("Miyoni", "we", "us") collects, uses and protects information when you use Smartbase at https://smartbase.de5.net and the related Auth & Email platform (together, the "Service"). Contact: [emalawi19@gmail.com](mailto:emalawi19@gmail.com).

## 1. Information we collect
**Account information.** When you sign in with Google we receive your name, email address, profile picture address and a Google account identifier through Google/Firebase Authentication. If you create an account with a username and password, we store your username, email and a salted hash of your password (never the password itself).

**Content you store.** Databases, table definitions, records, SQL statements you run, and files you upload. This is your content and we use it only to provide the Service to you.

**API keys and settings.** We store a hash of each API key, its type and when it was created or last used, along with your plan and settings.

**Usage and technical information.** Request logs and audit entries, including the type of operation, the database involved, a shortened copy of the SQL, success or failure, timing, and approximate location (country, region, city) provided by Cloudflare. Our hosting provider also processes your IP address and browser information to deliver and protect the Service. We use rate-limit counters to prevent abuse.

**Auth & Email platform.** For developers: project names, websites, settings, and credentials you provide (for example Google client secrets, Smartbase API keys and gateway secrets), which are encrypted before storage. For visitors of a developer's website who sign in with Google: name, email, profile picture address, Google account identifier, sign-in times, and, if the developer enables account control, a hashed identifier of the visitor's browser or device. For email broadcasts: recipient email addresses and names, and whether and when a message was sent, opened or unsubscribed (we use a small tracking image to detect opens).

**Cookies and browser storage.** We use a login session (a cookie or local browser storage) to keep you signed in, and preferences such as the theme. The Smartbase sign-in script on a developer's website may store a random device identifier in local storage and a first-party cookie.

## 2. How we use information
- To provide, secure and improve the Service, including authentication, storage, rate limiting and abuse prevention.
- To send service messages and, for developers who use broadcasts, to deliver their emails.
- To respond to support requests and comply with legal obligations.

We do not sell your personal information and we do not use your stored content for advertising.

## 3. Who we share information with
We use service providers to run the Service: Google (Firebase Authentication, Google sign-in, Gmail for sending email, Google Fonts), Cloudflare (hosting, networking and databases) and Hugging Face (private cloud storage for databases and files). If you connect your own external storage, such as Backblaze B2, your files go to the account you configured. Providers process information only to provide their services. We may disclose information if required by law or to protect the rights, safety and security of users and the Service.

If you are a developer who uses Smartbase to sign in visitors of your own website, you decide how that visitor data is used and stored (for example in your own database or on your own server), and you are responsible for informing your visitors and following the laws that apply to you.

## 4. Storage, security and retention
Data is protected in transit with HTTPS, access is checked on every request, passwords and API keys are stored as hashes, and sensitive credentials are encrypted. A small number of authorized Miyoni administrators can access operational data to run, support and secure the Service. No online service can be completely secure, so please protect your login and API keys.

We keep your information while your account is active and as long as needed to provide the Service and meet legal obligations. Our cloud storage keeps version history, so deleted content can remain in earlier versions for a period before it is removed.

## 5. International processing
Our providers operate in several countries, so your information may be processed outside the country where you live.

## 6. Your choices and rights
You can view and change your content in the dashboard, delete databases and files, revoke API keys, and ask us to delete your account. Email [emalawi19@gmail.com](mailto:emalawi19@gmail.com) to ask for access, correction, export or deletion of your personal information, or to object to certain processing. We aim to reply within 30 days. Email recipients can unsubscribe from broadcasts using the link in each message.

## 7. Children
The Service is not intended for children under 13 (or the minimum age required in your country). If you believe a child has given us personal information, contact us and we will delete it.

## 8. Public pages and web crawlers
This Privacy Policy, the About page, the Terms of Service and the documentation are public. Search engines, AI assistants and other crawlers may read them. Private areas of the Service, including the API and your dashboard, require authentication and are not meant to be crawled.

## 9. Changes
We may update this policy. We will change the date above and, for significant changes, tell you in the Service or by email.

## 10. Contact
Miyoni, [emalawi19@gmail.com](mailto:emalawi19@gmail.com).

# Terms of Service

Last updated: 18 October 2026

These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of Smartbase at https://smartbase.de5.net and the related Auth & Email platform (the "Service"), provided by Miyoni ("we", "us"). By creating an account or using the Service you agree to these Terms and to our [Privacy Policy](https://smartbase.de5.net/privacy).

## 1. The Service
Smartbase provides databases, SQL, a REST API, file storage, Google sign-in tools and email tools. The free plan has limits on databases, tables, files, requests and emails, described in the [documentation](https://smartbase.de5.net/docs). We may change, limit or discontinue features.

## 2. Your account
You must provide accurate information and keep your login and API keys secret. You are responsible for activity under your account and keys. Tell us at [emalawi19@gmail.com](mailto:emalawi19@gmail.com) if you suspect unauthorized use.

## 3. Your content
You own your content. You give us permission to store, process and transmit it only as needed to run the Service for you. You promise that you have the rights to your content and that it does not break the law or the rights of others.

## 4. Acceptable use
You may not use the Service to:
- break the law, or store or share illegal, abusive or harmful content;
- send spam or unsolicited bulk email, or send email to people who have unsubscribed;
- collect or store other people's personal information without a lawful basis and any consent that is required;
- distribute malware, attack, probe or overload the Service, or bypass limits, rate limits or security controls;
- resell or share your API keys, or use the Service to build a competing service by abusing it.

## 5. Developers who use Auth & Email
If you sign in visitors of your own website, you decide what happens to their data and you are responsible for your own privacy notice, consent and compliance. Email broadcasts must be relevant, honest and include the unsubscribe link we add.

## 6. Availability and backups
The Service is provided as is and may be unavailable or change without notice. Keep your own backups of important data. You can download an offline copy of your users' database from the Auth & Email platform.

## 7. Disclaimer and limit of liability
To the maximum extent permitted by law, we provide the Service without warranties of any kind, and we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses, lost profits or lost data. Our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid us for the Service in the 12 months before the claim, which for the free plan is zero.

## 8. Suspension and termination
You may stop using the Service and delete your account at any time. We may suspend or end access if you break these Terms, put the Service or other users at risk, or if the law requires it.

## 9. Changes
We may update these Terms. If you keep using the Service after a change takes effect, you accept the updated Terms. We will update the date above.

## 10. Contact
Questions about these Terms: [emalawi19@gmail.com](mailto:emalawi19@gmail.com).
